purpose: Machine-readable architectural blueprint of MyWallet designed to onboard AI coding agents implementing new features without redundant full-repo scans.

project.name: MyWallet
project.author: Alejandro Castro
project.description: Personal finance desktop application (Windows & macOS) built with Electron, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, Express, and SQLite.

howToAddAFeature: 1. Database: Add idempotent DDL (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS / ALTER TABLE guard) in server/src/db/schema.ts inside runMigrations().
2. Backend Types: Add domain interfaces in server/src/types/index.ts.

3. Backend Module: Create server/src/modules/<feature>/ with <feature>.schema.ts (Zod), <feature>.repository.ts (better-sqlite3 prepared statements), <feature>.service.ts (business logic), <feature>.controller.ts (asyncHandler), and <feature>.routes.ts.
4. Mount Router: Register router in server/src/routes/index.ts under /api/<feature>.
5. Frontend Types & API: Mirror DTOs in client/src/types/index.ts and add typed methods in client/src/services/api.ts.

6. State & Navigation: If global or month-scoped, expose state/refresh in client/src/context/WalletContext.tsx. If adding a top-level tab, update ViewId in client/src/types/index.ts, NAV_ITEMS in client/src/config/navigation.ts, and render in client/src/App.tsx.

7. UI Implementation: Create view under client/src/features/<feature>/, reuse UI primitives from client/src/components/ui/ (especially FormattedNumberInput for COP amounts) and formatMoney() from client/src/utils/format.ts.
8. Verify: Run `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` (which bundles server/dist/index.js and electron/dist/{main,preload}.js via esbuild).
criticalInvariantsAndGotchas: SQLite persistence: In production Electron, DB_PATH MUST be set by electron/src/main.ts to `<app.getPath('userData')>/data/mywallet.db` BEFORE requiring `server/dist/index.js`. Never store user DB inside the installation directory.

Native module bundling: `scripts/build-desktop.cjs` bundles server into a single CJS file (`server/dist/index.js`) with `external: ['better-sqlite3']` and copies `pdfkit/js/data/*.afm` to `server/dist/data`. Any new native C++ dependency must be added to `external` in `scripts/build-desktop.cjs` and `asarUnpack` in `electron-builder.yml`.
Express static dotfiles: `server/src/app.ts` serves `client/dist` with `{ dotfiles: 'allow' }` because paths may contain dot-prefixed folders (e.g., `.gemini`). Do not remove this option.
Onboarding lock: Once `app_settings` key `onboarding_completed` is `'1'`, the onboarding wizard permanently hides from normal UI to prevent corrupting live numbers.

Essential payments irreversibility: `POST /api/essentials/payments/:id/check` marks an installment `checked = 1` and automatically creates an expense transaction. Once checked, it cannot be unchecked.
Subcategory budget sync: Creating/updating/deleting a subcategory in `modules/categories` automatically recalculates and syncs the parent category's monthly budget (`unit_amount * frequency_month`).
Currency & number inputs: All amounts are in Colombian Pesos (COP). Use `FormattedNumberInput` for numeric inputs so thousands separators render automatically while emitting clean numeric strings.

Electron security: Keep `nodeIntegration: false`, `contextIsolation: true`, `sandbox: true`, `webSecurity: true`. Expose any new desktop capability exclusively via `electron/src/preload.ts` (`window.mywalletDesktop`) and `client/src/types/electron.d.ts`.
Auto-updater 404 tolerance: `electron/src/updater.ts` treats 404 / missing `latest*.yml` as `not-available` so users never see scary errors before the first GitHub Release is published.
Cross-platform packaging: `better-sqlite3` is a native addon; Windows `.exe` must be built on Windows and macOS `.dmg/.zip` on macOS (or via `.github/workflows/build-and-release.yml`).

electronDev.behavior: Probes http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/health; loads http://localhost:5173 in BrowserWindow; spawns embedded server on :4000 if external server is not running.

electronProduction.behavior: Electron main resolves unpacked `client/dist` and `server/dist/index.js`, sets `DB_PATH` in `userData/data/mywallet.db`, calls `startServer({ host: '127.0.0.1', port: 0, clientDistPath })`, and loads `http://127.0.0.1:<ephemeralPort>`.
electronProduction.shutdown: `before-quit` awaits `embeddedServer.stop()` which closes all HTTP keep-alive sockets and runs `PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)` before closing SQLite.

files.electron/src/main.ts: Single-instance lock, persistent DB path resolution, embedded Express bootstrap/shutdown, BrowserWindow creation with strict security flags, navigation/popup/webview blocking, IPC handlers.
files.electron/src/updater.ts: `electron-updater` integration with GitHub Releases, silent check 6s after boot, status broadcast via `updater:status`.

securityFlags.navigation: restricted to windowUrl & apiBaseUrl origins via will-navigate

tables.name: categories
tables.purpose: Income and expense categories (18 defaults seeded automatically, including Investments and Debt).

tables.name: subcategories
tables.purpose: Itemized recurring items under a category (e.g., Spotify, haircuts, stocks/real estate under Investments) that sum into the parent budget.

tables.name: transactions
tables.purpose: Ledger of all income and expense movements.

tables.name: budgets
tables.purpose: Monthly spending cap per expense category.

tables.name: goals
tables.purpose: Savings targets with deadlines and progress tracking.

tables.name: goal_contributions
tables.purpose: History of deposits (positive) and withdrawals (negative) for each savings goal.

tables.name: debts
tables.purpose: Personal debts with interest rate, monthly payment, due day, and avalanche prioritization.

tables.name: debt_payments
tables.purpose: Payments applied to debts, optionally linked to an auto-created expense transaction.

tables.name: essential_plans
tables.purpose: Recurring monthly payment plans for essential categories (Vivienda, Salud, Alimentación, Servicios, Transporte).

columns.name: frequency_month
columns.constraints: NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(frequency_month >= 1 AND frequency_month <= 31)

tables.name: essential_payments
tables.purpose: Monthly installment checklist rows generated from essential_plans; once checked=1 they are permanently locked.

backend.pattern: Layered Modular Architecture (routes -> controller -> service -> repository) with Zod validation and centralized errorHandler.

config.server/src/config/brand.ts: Brand constants & PDF logo path resolver.
config.server/src/config/env.ts: Typed env getters and dynamic resolveDbPath().
config.server/src/config/finance.ts: FINANCE_RULES (budgetWarningThreshold: 0.8, 50/30/20 rule, maxDebtToIncome: 0.36, 6-month trend) and DEBT_CATEGORY_NAME.

middlewares.server/src/middlewares/errorHandler.ts: Maps ZodError -> 400, HttpError -> statusCode, SQLITE_CONSTRAINT -> 409, fallback -> 500.

scripts.dev: Runs server + client in parallel for web development.
scripts.electron:dev: Runs server + client + Electron window in dev mode.
scripts.build: Builds client (Vite), server (esbuild + pdfkit .afm), and electron (esbuild main + preload).
scripts.typecheck: Typechecks server, client, and electron tsconfigs.
scripts.dist:win: Builds and packages Windows NSIS one-click .exe installer into release/.
scripts.dist:mac: Builds and packages macOS .dmg and .zip (arm64 + x64) into release/.

buildAndRelease.releaseTrigger: Push git tag matching `v*` (e.g. `git tag v1.0.0 && git push origin v1.0.0`) or manual `workflow_dispatch`.
